branches.conclusion: The complete official 2026–27 Business Administration PhD concentration list has Accounting, Finance, Human Resource Management, Information Systems and Marketing, without Operations or Management Science. A 2016 official curriculum bulletin records that former Operations Management PhD concentration was renamed Supply Chain Management effective fall 2015; that historical title is not a current route.

Full 2026–27 university program and school hierarchy inventory shows Industrial and Systems Engineering only at B.S. level, not a doctorate. Detailed Applied Mathematics, Pure Mathematics and Computer Science PhD specifications were each opened; none offers a formally named Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering specialization. Current engineering PhD title inventory lists Aerospace, Aviation Science and Mechatronics only.
